# Phase One — Chessed Unbounded Continuation

The Awtsmoos gives every instant new possibility; Awtsmoos.com should reveal that possibility through one coherent, trustworthy economy and one professional product universe.

## Seven Immediate Rivers
1. Paid-action reservation/commit/release so compute failures never steal credits.
2. Representative credit sinks with clear user value and preserved task context.
3. Product-readiness graph enforcing route, SKU, credit, fulfillment, support, SEO and test truth.
4. Crawlable Apps/Games marketplace inventory plus product metadata and structured data.
5. Mobile/a11y/performance hardening of global shells and commerce.
6. Search/recents/favorites/workflow primitives generated from canonical catalog truth.
7. Observability/economy reconciliation and anti-abuse evidence around paid actions.

## Unlimited Expansion Beyond The Seven
- Generated product-detail pages, screenshots, OpenGraph, sitemap and release notes.
- PWA/offline/install manifests from canonical product truth.
- Cross-app handoff contracts and workflow recipes.
- Game progression, cosmetics, achievements and capped rewards without pay-to-win.
- Team wallets, organization policy, invoices and shared budgets.
- Creator marketplace only after provenance, moderation, settlement, fraud and licensing foundations.
